landing.heroSubtitle: Be a Buddy is a warm, verified community where you meet real people who share your values — for faith, friendship, growth, love and every adventure in between.
landing.trustLine: Verified real people · Built-in safety tools · Pay your way
landing.circlesSubtitle: One identity, many Circles. Verify once, then choose where you show up — a church member never sees your dating profile.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Every profile carries a short list of goals, so connections have a reason to last.
landing.featureGoalsDesc: Post 3–5 goals. Buddies cheer you on, join in or hold you accountable.
landing.featureMatcherDesc: Matched on goals, values, area and availability — with a one-line why you match.
landing.featureSafetyDesc: Verified members, share-my-plan, check-in timer and in-app SOS.
landing.featureMpesaDesc: Tickets, plans and event fees — pay by card, PayPal or ACH bank transfer.
landing.howStep1Desc: Sign up with your phone number from anywhere in the world. Add a photo and your city.
landing.howStep2Desc: Choose Friends, Faith, Work, Spark and more — then set your goals.
landing.howStep3Desc: Get matched, join groups and show up to real meetups near you.

safety.subtitle: Safety is the product. Verify yourself, build trust and carry your safety kit.
safety.stepPhoneDesc: Verified when you signed up. Required for everyone.
safety.stepSelfieDesc: A quick selfie check. Needed to message or attend events.
safety.stepIdDesc: Confirm your ID. Required for Spark, hosts and paid events.

safety.sosDesc: Share your live location with your trusted contacts right now.

spark.godlyDatingBody: Spark is built for intentional, respectful relationships. Whether faith is central to your life or not, we ask every member to treat others with dignity, honesty and care — as you would want to be treated yourself.
spark.godlyDatingTip1: Be honest about your intentions from the start.
spark.godlyDatingTip2: Respect boundaries — a no is always final.
spark.godlyDatingTip3: Meet in public first, and use your Safety Kit every time.
spark.godlyDatingTip4: Build genuine connection before moving quickly.
spark.godlyDatingTip5: Keep chats on Be a Buddy until you truly trust someone.

meetupDisclaimer.heading: Stay safe when you meet up
meetupDisclaimer.tip1: Meet in a busy public place — a café, restaurant or well-lit open venue.
meetupDisclaimer.tip2: Tell a trusted contact where you are going, when, and who you are meeting.
meetupDisclaimer.tip3: Arrive and leave independently on your first meeting. Do not share your home address.
meetupDisclaimer.tip4: Trust your instincts — never feel pressured to stay if something feels wrong.
meetupDisclaimer.tip5: Report anything suspicious to Be a Buddy straight away.
